summary: This clinical trial is testing the study drugs macupatide and eloralintide in participants who are overweight or have obesity but do not have Type 2 diabetes. The study is sponsored by Eli Lilly and Company and aims for an enrollment of 60 participants. It is currently in Phase 1 and has a status of Not yet recruiting. Participants will receive different combinations of the study drugs or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real drug.
